Senior Full-Stack JavaScript Engineer (React / Next.js / Node.js) 
 About the Company 
 For one of our clients, a fast-growing international technology company developing a SaaS platform for sales automation and customer engagement, we are looking for a Senior Full-Stack JavaScript Engineer to join its engineering team.
 The company operates in a fast-paced, product-driven environment where engineers have significant ownership, influence technical decisions, and contribute directly to product development.
 This opportunity is ideal for an experienced engineer who enjoys building scalable products, shipping features quickly, leveraging AI-powered development tools, and solving complex problems with minimal supervision.
 About the Role 
 As a Senior Full-Stack JavaScript Engineer, you will take ownership of product features throughout their entire lifecycle, from understanding business requirements and designing solutions to implementation, deployment, and continuous improvement.
 You will work across the frontend, backend, and database layers, contributing to a production SaaS platform used by customers internationally.
 We are looking for someone who combines strong technical expertise, product thinking, high autonomy, and an AI-first development mindset .
 Experience requirements 
 Strong JavaScript fundamentals and experience shipping and maintaining production applications across the full stack. 
 Experience building responsive, intuitive interfaces with React and Next.js. 
 Experience developing backend services and APIs with Node.js and frameworks such as Fastify. 
 Experience with PostgreSQL, including data modeling, writing SQL, and investigating query performance. 
 Experience integrating third-party services, working with background jobs, and debugging production issues. 
 What we’re looking for 
 A track record of moving fast. You know how to simplify a solution, avoid unnecessary complexity, and deliver quickly while protecting the parts customers depend on.
 High agency. You notice what needs doing and act on it. You find missing context, work through blockers, and carry work through to completion.
 Independent thinking. You form your own view, explain your decisions, and challenge an approach when you see a better one. You know when to make a call and when to bring someone in.
 Good product instincts. You understand the customer’s goal, spot awkward workflows, and distinguish between essential polish and details that can wait.
 An established AI workflow. You already use AI coding tools heavily and can show how they help you deliver better work faster.
 Clear communication. You keep teammates informed, raise issues early, and make collaboration easy without needing constant check-ins.
 What you’ll do 
 Own features end to end. Take work from the initial problem through implementation, release, and follow-up across the frontend, backend, and database.
 Ship quickly and iterate. Break work into useful releases, make thoughtful scope cuts, and improve what you ship based on customer feedback.
 Build with AI every day. Use AI tools throughout development to accelerate research, implementation, testing, and debugging. Review the output critically and take responsibility for the result.
 Make product decisions. Identify friction, question assumptions, and help decide what deserves attention. Care about how a feature feels to use as much as whether it works.
 Keep the platform dependable. Build and improve APIs, integrations, and background jobs. Investigate production issues and fix their underlying causes.
